summary.behavior: Revive-event handler (wired by __init__ via callback::on_revived). Ordered: (1) early-return unless gamestate::is_state("playing"); (2) early-return unless isplayer(params.reviver); (3) early-return unless isdefined(params.attacker); (4) early-return if params.attacker.team === params.reviver.team (same-team downing excluded); (5) weapon = getweapon("bare_hands"); (6) scoreevents::processscoreevent("revives", params.reviver, undefined, weapon). Net effect: awards the 'revives' score event to the reviving player when the downed player had been downed by an enemy (attacker on a different team). All reads are of the event params; only write is through processscoreevent.

Team comparison uses strict === on team fields; non-equal teams proceed
